column1: CurNum - current number of the meteor in the look-up table.
SolLon - ecliptic longitude of Sun at the meteor instant (J2000).
SCELoG - Sun centered ecliptic longitude of the geocentric radiant.
ELaG -  ecliptic latitude of the geocentric radiant.
IAUNo -   IAU numerical code of the shower.
IAUCoe -  IAU 3 letter code of the shower.            Not obligatory
CatCod -  code of the source catalogue of the meteor. Not obligatory
MetCod -  meteor code given in the source catalogue.  Not obligatory
